content.text: Let me test the basis optimizer against a full exhaustive search (no dedupe reduction) on random matrices.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main
rng=random.Random(3)
for it in range(200):
    nprof=rng.randint(1,8); nq=rng.randint(0,12)
    pids=['p%d'%i for i in range(nprof)]
    qs=[{'id':'q%02d'%i,'cost':rng.randint(1,20)} for i in range(nq)]
    # random signatures as tuples of small ints
    sig={}
    for p in pids:
        for q in qs:
            sig[(q['id'],p)]=(rng.randint(0,2), rng.randint(0,3))
    # classes
    assigned=set(); classes=[]
    for p in pids:
        if p in assigned: continue
        mem=[x for x in pids if x not in assigned and all(sig[(q['id'],p)]==sig[(q['id'],x)] for q in qs)]
        for x in mem: assigned.add(x)
        classes.append(sorted(mem))
    classes.sort()
    basis,cost,count=main.minimum_basis(qs,pids,sig,classes)
    # exhaustive no reduction
    pairs=[(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2) if any(sig[(q['id'],a)]!=sig[(q['id'],b)] for q in qs)]
    best=None
    for r in range(nq+1):
        for sub in itertools.combinations(qs,r):
            if all(any(sig[(q['id'],a)]!=sig[(q['id'],b)] for q in sub) for a,b in pairs):
                key=(sum(q['cost'] for q in sub),len(sub))
                if best is None or key<best: best=key
    if best is None: best=(0,0)
    assert (cost,count)==best,(it,(cost,count),best)
    # validate basis coverage
    bset=set(basis)
    assert all(any(sig[(q['id'],a)]!=sig[(q['id'],b)] for q in bset) for a,b in pairs)
    assert basis==sorted(basis) and count==len(basis)
print('basis fuzz ok')
PY
